_doc: Style registry for sketch-illustration. Add your own styles here; gen.sh --style <name> uses the prompt from this file.

infografico.label: Sketch editorial hand-drawn (Christoph Niemann + Tim Urban)
infografico.when_to_use: IG Story, explainer post, Twitter card, post visual com 5-9 elementos nomeados, propaganda
infografico.prefix: Hand-drawn editorial illustration in mixed-media style: confident black ink line-work + watercolor wash backgrounds + colored marker fills. Style reference: New York Times explainer illustration, Christoph Niemann, modern visual essay. Colors: warm paper texture base #FAF6EE, with VIBRANT filled regions in warm orange #E97A4F, muted teal #4A9B95, warm yellow #F5C04A, soft coral #F0876B, dusty blue #6B9BD2, sage green #8AB97F. Color is APPLIED LIBERALLY across backgrounds, character clothes, object fills, not just accent dots. Real recognizable brand logos with their official brand colors when shown. Hand-lettered marker typography. Setting: include scene context (a room, a desk, a city skyline, a workshop), not floating elements on white. Paper texture visible behind everything. Generous orange marker arrows connecting beats.
infografico.suffix: Aspect ratio 9:16 (vertical Instagram Story / Reels format). Style reference: Christoph Niemann + Maira Kalman + Tim Urban illustrated essay. Crisp readable hand-lettered text. Story format: clear top headline, central illustration, bottom callout/CTA. Designed for social media share, bold enough to read on phone, warm enough to feel human.

diagrama.label: Whiteboard minimal 16:9 (técnico, propostas, slides)
diagrama.when_to_use: Explicar arquitetura, propostas técnicas, slides, infraestrutura, fluxo entre componentes
diagrama.prefix: Hand-drawn ink illustration on warm off-white paper background, sketchy line-art with confident black ink strokes, hand-lettered marker typography. Color palette: black ink line-work + bold accent colors used selectively (warm orange #E97A4F as primary accent, plus muted teal #4A9B95 and warm yellow #F5C04A for secondary highlights). Use REAL recognizable brand logos with their official brand colors when shown. Logos must be drawn loose and sketchy but unmistakable. Layout: clean composition, generous white space, hand-drawn arrows in orange connecting elements, casual hand-lettered all-caps labels.
diagrama.suffix: Aspect ratio 16:9. Style reference: whiteboard explainer drawn by a senior designer, like a Pixar storyboard or Tim Urban Wait But Why illustration. Crisp readable text, sketchy but professional.
